jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist, Computational Pathology
jobs.description_text: About Us: Artera is an artificial intelligence company dedicated to transforming cancer care. We’ve developed foundation models that analyze clinical and pathology data, generating actionable insights that guide therapy selection and improve outcomes for cancer patients. By continuously improving these models, we aim to uncover the biological mechanisms driving cancer progression. Build ML that changes how cancer is treated. Most medical AI stops with a publication. Our AI models guide treatment decisions today. Artera’s AI-driven prostate test is standard-of-care in the US and cancer patients in all 50 states are using our models to help make decisions about their therapy. While we started in prostate cancer, we’ve grown into a multi-cancer platform with more disease settings in development. You'll help build what's next. The role At Artera, we’re making ML development agent-first. You won’t spend your days hand-writing training loops, tuning hyperparameters in notebooks, or babysitting individual runs. Instead, you’ll design, direct, and evaluate autonomous research agents that propose hypotheses, write and execute experiments, and train models autonomously. You’ll be tasked with answering specific scientific questions: which patients can safely forgo aggressive treatment or inferring molecular traits from routine digital slides and your job will be to decide what’s worth investigating and which research directions merit investment. jobs.description_text: As a senior or staff scientist, you'll own an AI biomarker end to end, from problem framing with our product, medical, and biostatistics partners through validation, regulatory submission, and production. You'll set technical direction for the scientists and engineers around you, and take on the hardest cross-cutting problems in our field: making models hold up across scanners, stains, and sites so a patient’s result doesn’t depend on the scanner, lab, or stain behind their slide, uncovering what our models have learned about tumor biology, and building the next generation of our pathology foundation models. At the Staff level, you'll also set direction across programs and help shape the AI roadmap with leadership.

CLO 소프트웨어의 기존 숙련도는 요구하지 않으며, 입사 후 새로운 IT 기술을 빠르게 습득하여 기존 패션 실무 지식과 결합할 수 있는 역량(Tech Savviness)을 중점적으로 평가합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [CLO Software Test] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] (1차 인터뷰 합격자에게는 2차 면접 전, CLO 사전 학습용 교육 자료 및 임시 라이선스가 제공됩니다. 2차 면접 시 진행되는 테스트는 기존의 CLO 숙련도가 아닌, 새로운 소프트웨어를 빠르게 습득하는 학습 능력과 패션 구조에 대한 이해도를 평가하기 위한 과정입니다.) jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role Sourcing is where the money is actually decided. We are expanding our Data Capture Research team in Prague with a Senior Data Scientist to work on Sourcing. Which suppliers get invited. How the event is structured. How bids that differ in price, lead time, quality, risk and carbon get compared at all. What a fair price even is. When to award, to whom, and how to split the award across suppliers. For a researcher this is unusually open ground - not one model family, but several, on the same data: Recommendation and retrieval. Supplier discovery: matching demand to the right suppliers across a 10M-node network. Forecasting and should-cost modelling. What this category, in this region, at this volume, should cost right now. Game theory and mechanism design. Auction formats, bidding behaviour, incentives, and competitive dynamics between real counterparties. Combinatorial optimisation. Award allocation under volume, capacity and multi-sourcing constraints. Multimodal document understanding. RFPs, specs, quotes and contracts carry the actual requirements - and our T-LLM foundations already give us a head start there. Part of the work is choosing the right instrument for each - neural networks, gradient boosting, optimisation, bandits, mechanism design - instead of forcing one. Takes the high-level solution — what the business needs, what data is available — and elaborates it into detailed, buildable integration specifications: field-level mappings, data contracts, error handling, edge cases. Unlike a pure spec-writer, this role also writes code directly on integrations when doing so is faster than a full handoff, working alongside the Integration Engineers. Owns the consumption-side relationship with the Data/Analytics team that curates the mart. Does not own or build the data mart itself.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Technical Recruiter to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about hiring top talent to work on satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for building a pipeline of candidates to help develop leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems. You will collaborate with hiring managers and key stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top talent in various technical disciplines within the aerospace industry. This is a multifaceted job that requires strong technical aptitude and the ability to effectively assess the technical capabilities of candidates, along with outstanding organizational skills and the ability to understand and promote the value proposition Cesium offers. Talent acquisition activities will include sourcing candidates from a variety of platforms and helping to develop high-impact recruiting strategies. You will work closely with Cesium engineering and business staff to develop and execute talent acquisition projects.

jobs.title: Spectrum Engineer II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Spectrum Engineer II to our team. In this role you will support the design, development, integration, and testing of communications systems, including satellite spectrum coordination and regulatory compliance activities. This role performs communications system analyses, evaluates performance and interference considerations, and prepares technical documentation supporting system development, and licensing requirements. Using established engineering methods and regulatory guidelines, the Spectrum Engineer II resolves routine technical challenges and supports compliance with International Telecommunication Union (ITU) and Federal Communications Commission (FCC) requirements. Working cross-functionally with systems, software, RF, electrical, mechanical, integration and test, quality, regulatory, and program teams, this role supports communications systems engineering from concept development through integration, verification, and production while contributing to satellite licensing, regulatory filings, and spectrum coordination activities.

jobs.title: Quality Control Specialist
jobs.description_text: DNA Genotek, a part of OraSure Technologies Inc (OTI), develops products that optimize ease of collection and provide superior samples. DNA provides proven performance for those requiring high-quality biological samples for nucleic acid testing. Overview DNA Genotek products are marketed worldwide and support thousands of customers as they achieve breakthroughs in genomic and microbiome research, in diagnostics laboratories, in the pharmaceutical industry, in companion animal genomics and in personalized medicine. This job posting is to hire for an existing vacancy. Quality Control Specialist personnel executes written procedures that include evaluation of raw materials, finished products, equipment and product performance in compliance with guidelines established by OraSure Technologies and regulatory agencies. The base salary range for this full-time position is 45,000-75,000. This is a one year contract position.

jobs.title: Lead, Electrical Engineer
jobs.description_text: Job Description: As a Lead Electrical Engineer within our Surveillance product line, you are focused on developing TCAS and transponder radios, owning the electrical engineering discipline through initial concept generation, design, qualification, and lifecycle management. You will interact with business development and all engineering functions, with specific focus on relating the requirements for top-level product development to the specific technical areas of electrical engineering. You will be involved with multidisciplinary project teams involving mechanical, electrical digital/analog, RF, firmware, and software engineering in planning, designing, prototyping, and testing of avionics transponders, RF, and sensor-based systems. You will additionally be responsible for mentorship of junior engineers, as well as ensuring the Surveillance product line follows industry best-practices for product development. Design focus will include surveillance avionics for Air Transport, as well as General Aviation and emerging platforms such as Urban Air Mobility (UAM) eVTOL aircraft.

jobs.title: Specialist, Software Engineer  - Verification and Validation
jobs.description_text: Job Title: Software V&V Engineer – Surveillance Position Summary: As a Software V&V Engineer, you will execute hands-on software verification and validation activities in compliance with DO-178C objectives for safety-critical avionics surveillance systems. Acron Aviation is seeking detail-oriented, technically rigorous V&V engineers who can execute and document software verification activities and contribute to airworthiness certification on our TCAS, Transponder, and Integrated Surveillance Platform programs. The applicant will work as a key individual contributor within the Software V&V team, collaborating with Systems Engineering, Software Development, and Program Management to ensure verification coverage, requirements traceability, and compliance with applicable DO-178C DAL B and C requirements. As an individual contributor, the Software V&V Engineer is responsible for hands-on execution and documentation of software verification activities within assigned programs, ensuring DO-178C compliance and collaborating with Software Development Leads and Project Leads on test integration, schedule, and certification readiness.
